summary: UI text-layout helper on the UITextRenderWithScale (004D7E40) path, sibling of the centering helper at 004D7F20. Resolves an owner object via SwitchBasedGlobalLookup(a4); only when non-null it measures text through sub_5531F0 into a4, then stores a2 - a4 into *a3 (extent minus measured size) and returns a3. On a null lookup it returns null and leaves a3 untouched.

local_names.a1: render/anchor context passed to the measuring helper
local_names.a2: available extent used as the subtraction base
local_names.a3: output pointer receiving the computed position
local_names.a4: lookup key; after the measuring call holds the measured text size

operations.description: Resolve the owner object by key a4 through SwitchBasedGlobalLookup; the non-null result gates the whole body
If the global lookup returned null, skip the body and return that null result directly
Measure text metrics for context a1, writing the measured size back through &a4 and the re-derived context through &a1, with a 0 flag
Computed position: *a3 = a2 - a4 (extent minus full measured size)
Store the computed position into the output slot *a3
Return a3 (the output slot pointer) so the caller can chain on the stored value
Invoked from UITextRenderWithScale (004D7E40) as part of scaled text layout
